title: Capital Raising - Worldwide
highlights: The total capital raised in the Capital Raising market market worldwide is projected to reach US$441.06bn in 2026.
Traditional Capital Raising is expected to dominate the market with a projected market volume of US$384.59bn in 2026.
When compared globally, the United States is anticipated to generate the most capital raised, with US$266.2bn in 2026.
Worldwide, the trend in the Capital Raising market shows a surge in innovative crowdfunding platforms, revolutionizing access to capital for entrepreneurs across the globe.
